declaration.negotiation_history_statement: Whitcombe Reyes LLP and Brightline’s counsel negotiated the settlement over several exchanges. The parties discussed class relief and attorneys’ fees together from the outset; fees were not deferred until after class relief was agreed. The resulting agreement provides a $28.2 million class fund, distributed automatically to identified members, and up to $3.3 million in fees and expenses paid separately, subject to court approval. Brightline has not agreed to refrain from opposing the fee request, and any amount the court declines to award will go to the class rather than revert to Brightline. This statement does not disclose the parties’ confidential mediation offers.
